# PRD-BLD-02

**Does an as-built record show the built solution matches this version of the design, with every departure either designed in a new version or recorded as a decision?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | BLD: As built |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `evidence.type`, `evidence.design_version`, `decisions` |

## Why it matters

TOGAF's compliance review compares implementation with architecture; a solution that departs from its design has not been assessed, whatever its design review said.

## Rule

evidence has an entry of type as-built-record whose design_version equals design.version. A reviewer reads it and sets the verdict's as_built level.

## Sources

- The Open Group, TOGAF Standard 10th Edition, Enterprise Architecture Capability and Governance, chapter 6, Architecture Compliance (`togaf-compliance`)
- The Open Group, TOGAF Standard 10th Edition, ADM, Phase G, Implementation Governance (`togaf-phase-g`)
